_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil: dead flows and crowded longs vs fed liquidity and still-elevated skew have not ejected the score from the Anxiety band.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Anxiety; narrative descriptive only (skew fade) with no opposing forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~40-55 and BTC remains range-bound with no ETF-flow or 30d-momentum impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound and F&G pushes mid-50s (toward Complacency), or momentum breaks with F&G into low-30s (toward Denial)
